personality_one_liner: A high-visibility, stark, and ultra-functional command surface designed for rapid warehouse operations.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids and thick dividers. Elements should snap to edges where possible. Inner padding uses sm and md. Whitespace is intentional and blocky.

dont's: Do not use glass or blur. Everything should be solid, stark, and high-contrast.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A single brutalist input screen for the user to enter their name before starting the session.
screens.layout: Center-aligned massive typography ('SIAPA NAMA ANDA?'). A single edge-to-edge thick-bordered text input. A full-width #00E676 primary button locked to the keyboard.

screens.name: Main Scan
screens.purpose: Split-screen command center: top half for barcode scanning and qty input, bottom half for the running list of scanned products.

states.loading: Scanner initializing (black rectangle with 'MEMUAT KAMERA' mono text).
states.empty: List empty state: A thick-bordered box in the bottom half with 'BELUM ADA DATA' mono text.
states.error: Camera error state: Red box with 'KAMERA ERROR'.

screens.layout: Top Section (Scan & Input): A rectangular camera viewport (approx 150px height) at the very top. Below it, a product details block (black border). If a barcode maps to multiple codes, display a horizontal scroll of selectable chip-buttons (hard square, border). Below that, a 3-column qty input row (Karton | Lusin | Pcs) with mono-font inputs. Full-width 'SIMPAN' button. Bottom Section (Results List): A scrollable list with 2pt top border. Each row has a 2pt bottom border. Row layout: Left side index number (oversized mono), middle side Code & Name, right side stacked Karton/Lusin/Pcs counts. Double-tap row to open Edit/Delete sheet.

screens.name: Master Data
screens.purpose: Screen to view, import, and add new master products.

states.empty: Large mono text: 'MASTER PRODUK KOSONG'. Primary button: 'IMPORT CSV/XLS'.

screens.layout: Header with 'DATA MASTER' and a '+' button. Two prominent full-width action buttons: 'IMPORT EXCEL/CSV' and 'TAMBAH MANUAL'. Below them, a rigid list of existing master products. Add Manual opens a modal/sheet with Barcode, Code, and Name inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality: NO border radius (0px everywhere), NO shadows, NO glassmorphism, 2pt solid black (#000000) borders for all structural elements, buttons, and inputs.
Use 'Space Grotesk' for display/headings and 'Space Mono' for all text, labels, numbers, and inputs.

Split Screen Implementation: Wrap the entire Main screen in a rigid layout. The top scan/input form shouldn't scroll if possible; only the bottom results list should scroll. Use Flexbox to divide them (e.g., top flex: 0.6, bottom flex: 0.4 or allow the list to take remaining space).

Code Selector: If 'Satu barcode product bisa memiliki 2 atau lebih kode', conditionally render a horizontal scrollview of square, bordered chips right under the scanner. The user MUST select one before the 'SIMPAN' button is enabled.
Quantity Inputs: Render 3 square/rigid input fields side-by-side for 'Karton', 'Lusin', 'Pcs'. Default value 0. Use numeric keyboards.
Scan Result Row: Include 'nomor urut' (index number), Barcode, Kode, Nama, and Qty. Style it like a data table row with thick borders.
Interaction: Implement 'Double tap' on the list row using `GestureDetector` or `TouchableWithoutFeedback` to trigger a brutalist bottom sheet for Edit/Delete.
Add New Product: If a scanned barcode is NOT in the master list, immediately show a prominent prompt/modal: 'PRODUK TIDAK DITEMUKAN. TAMBAH KE MASTER?'.
Offline Storage & Export: Use AsyncStorage or SQLite for local storage. Implement export to CSV feature via expo-file-system and expo-sharing.
